def test_build_export_ledger_rules(tmp_path):
    import json
    from invoice import build_export, load, write_export
    rows = load("data/lines.csv")
    export = build_export(rows)
    assert [i["id"] for i in export["invoices"]] == ["I100"]
    inv = export["invoices"][0]
    assert [l["amount"] for l in inv["lines"]] == ["0.34", "0.34", "0.34", "-0.10"]
    assert inv["total"] == "0.92" == str(total(rows))
    assert inv["lines"][3]["tax_class"] == "exempt"
    out = write_export(rows, tmp_path / "build" / "x.json")
    assert json.loads(out.read_text()) == export


def test_build_export_groups_and_sorts():
    from invoice import build_export
    rows = [
        {"invoice": "B", "item": "x", "quantity": "1", "unit_price": "1.005", "tax_class": ""},
        {"invoice": "A", "item": "y", "quantity": "2", "unit_price": "0.10", "tax_class": "std"},
        {"invoice": "B", "item": "z", "quantity": "1", "unit_price": "1.005", "tax_class": ""},
    ]
    inv = build_export(rows)["invoices"]
    assert [i["id"] for i in inv] == ["A", "B"]
    assert inv[1]["total"] == "2.02"  # per-line rounding; rounding once gives 2.01
    assert "tax_class" not in inv[1]["lines"][0]
